summary: Sponsor-reported priority review and two randomized phase 3 trials establish development progress, but no efficacy results or safety findings are supplied to assess benefit–risk. Manufacturing evidence is also absent.
pivotalQuestion: What sustained off-treatment functional-cure benefit and safety profile did B-Well 1 and B-Well 2 demonstrate?

factors.rationale: Two randomized phase 3 B-Well trials evaluate sustained undetectable HBsAg after treatment cessation, not viral eradication. No efficacy results are supplied.
No adverse-event, tolerability, or comparative safety findings are supplied.
No product-linked manufacturing or facility-compliance evidence is supplied.
Ionis reported NDA acceptance and priority review, with the October 26 target reaffirmed in July. These are process milestones, not evidence of efficacy or approval.
